answer.origin: Third-party media: Motley Fool article by Robert Izquierdo, published 2026-08-01, citing company filings as data source (data as of July 31, 2026). Not a company disclosure.
answer.note: Motley Fool (Aug 1, 2026) reports Nvidia revenue of $81.6B for the quarter ended April 2026, with a company forecast of about $91B for the next quarter, and says the new Vera Rubin AI platform is expected to support growth. Net income margin of 72% for the quarter ended April 26, 2026 is also reported. The article names Alphabet as an Nvidia customer but gives no purchase amount. Alphabet's Q2 2026 Google Cloud revenue of $24.8B (up 82% year over year) and cloud backlog above $500B (up from $462B in Q1) are Alphabet figures, not Nvidia orders; they can inform AI demand context only through the explained channel that Alphabet buys Nvidia compute, and do not establish Nvidia's order book. Conditional reading: the article supports continued strong Nvidia revenue momentum and a guided sequential increase, but the forecast is a single-source media restatement of a company outlook and its exact statement date is not given.
limitations: The article's quarterly revenue list is unlabeled by company and mixes Nvidia and Alphabet values, so the chart cannot be used to attribute individual quarters without checking primary filings.
The $91B next-quarter figure is reported as a company forecast but the article gives no statement date, period definition or guidance range, so its precision and currency are unverified.
Alphabet's purchase amounts from Nvidia are not disclosed, so the customer relationship cannot be sized from this source.
Google Cloud revenue and backlog are Alphabet figures and do not measure Nvidia orders, backlog or demand for Nvidia products.
follow_up: Check Nvidia's earnings release or 10-Q for the quarter ended April 26, 2026 to confirm the $81.6B revenue and 72% net income margin.
Check Nvidia's most recent guidance statement for the $91B next-quarter outlook, including its date, range and whether it is GAAP or non-GAAP.
Check Nvidia's customer concentration disclosure in its filings for any named or percentage-level revenue attributable to Alphabet.
